headline.title: Nvidia’s RTX Spark Laptops Look Hell-Bent on Disruption
headline.summary: Nvidia has introduced its RTX Spark laptops, powered by new RTX Spark chips designed to enhance AI capabilities in personal computing. This development aims to advance the concept of the "AI PC" and potentially disrupt the current laptop market.

articles.title: What’s Worth More Than Cash in San Francisco Real Estate? Anthropic Stock
articles.summary: In the San Francisco Bay Area, some real estate listings are now accepting Anthropic stock as a form of payment for homes, highlighting the increasing value of AI companies in the local market. This trend reflects a growing intersection between technology investments and real estate transactions.

articles.title: AI has a water problem. Google thinks it has a fix
articles.summary: Google has announced five commitments aimed at reducing the environmental impact of its AI data centers, including a goal to replenish more water for local communities. This initiative comes in response to growing concerns about the water usage associated with AI infrastructure development in the U.S.

articles.title: Google must let publishers opt out of AI Search features, rules UK
articles.summary: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority has mandated that Google allow online publishers to opt out of having their content included in AI Search features. This ruling aims to give publishers greater control over the use of their material in Google's AI-driven services.

articles.title: Cyera eyes $12B valuation at 80x ARR multiple despite operating losses
articles.summary: Cyera, a cybersecurity firm, is approaching a $300 million funding round led by Evolution Equity Partners, aiming for a valuation of $12 billion at an 80x ARR multiple despite currently operating at a loss. The investment reflects strong investor interest in the cybersecurity sector amid increasing demand for data protection solutions.

articles.title: Redditors Are Using AI to Beat Obscene World Cup Ticket Prices
articles.summary: Reddit users on r/WorldCup2026Tickets are leveraging AI tools like Claude to create their own ticketing software and facilitate ticket exchanges, effectively countering high prices set by scalpers. This collaborative effort aims to make World Cup tickets more accessible to fans.

articles.title: Microsoft Build 2026: The 7 biggest announcements
articles.summary: Microsoft Build 2026 featured key announcements from CEO Satya Nadella, including new Surface hardware, an always-on personal assistant, and updates to the company's AI models. The event highlighted significant advancements in Microsoft's technology offerings and services.

articles.title: Uber caps employee AI spending after blowing through budget in 4 months
articles.summary: Uber has imposed a cap on employee spending related to AI after exceeding its budget within just four months. This decision follows a previous initiative encouraging staff to leverage AI technologies extensively.

articles.title: Leveraging BART to Assess CS1 C++ Programming Assignments using Rubric-based Criteria
articles.summary: This paper explores the use of BART, a transformer model, for the automated grading of introductory C++ programming assignments by fine-tuning it with rubric-based criteria. The study aims to enhance grade predictions to align more closely with instructor evaluations, utilizing multi-semester data from CS1 courses.

articles.title: Tracking Urban Atmospheric Pollutants using Sentinel-5P Satellite Data
articles.summary: A study utilizing Sentinel-5P satellite data has developed a framework for tracking urban nitrogen dioxide (NO2) pollution in Guayas Province, Ecuador, focusing on robust distributional metrics rather than surface concentration estimates. The research highlights the spatial and temporal variability of NO2 as a significant indicator of combustion-related air pollution in urban areas.

articles.title: Auditable Climate Risk Intelligence from Fragmented ESG Data: Deterministic Orchestration and Imbalance-Aware Learning for Scope 1-3 Validation
articles.summary: The paper presents a framework for enhancing climate risk intelligence by addressing the fragmentation of ESG data across Scope 1, 2, and 3 reporting. It emphasizes the need for improved validation processes that incorporate provenance-aware auditability, anomaly detection, and ensemble learning techniques to ensure reliable climate risk assessments.

articles.title: Samudra 2: Scaling Ocean Emulators across Resolutions
articles.summary: The article discusses Samudra 2, an advanced autoregressive neural ocean emulator designed to enhance the efficiency of ocean general circulation models (OGCMs) by enabling multi-decade global rollouts at a $1^\circ$ resolution. This development aims to address the computational limitations of existing ocean emulators, facilitating larger ensemble sizes and more diverse forcing scenarios in climate science.
